propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay (surface-parity) must be added to flag when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (lib _lib_writes.py, CLI _commands/, MCP _mcp_writes.py) without synchronized updates to sibling adapters.

The overlay must be configured as non-blocking (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with a reviewer prompt that carries false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergence, adapter-bound non-caller-visible params, and internal-only refactors.

The overlay must be wired into the four-pass code-review gate topology via round_a and round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched when write-surface files are modified, matching the deletion-impact / api-compat pattern.

The overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS, routed in criteria_routing.json with exec=AGENT and write-surface globs (applies_to), and listed in the base-reviewer catalog (code-review-base.md) with test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids remaining green.
The packaged reviewer prompt (code-review-surface-parity.md) must be excluded from reviewers/index.json (overlays not in the selection catalog by design) and drift-gate must pass as a no-op.
Unit and workflow tests must assert overlay membership, routing shape, glob firing on each write adapter, round_a/round_b dispatch, and that advisory threshold (0.95, False) is resolved correctly.
